meta.name: exporta-cards-enriquecidos-para-epub
meta.description: Exporta cards enriquecidos para EPUB (e-book) compatível com Google Play Books para leitura no celular

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将卡片内容导出为EPUB电子书
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想把卡片笔记导出为手机可读的电子书
copy.tagline_en: Export card content to EPUB e-book
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to export your card notes as an e-book readable on your phone

howto.what: 将当前目录下所有 `*-enriched-card.md` 文件转换为一个 EPUB 电子书，包含封面、目录、每张卡片的问题和答案，并优化手机阅读。
howto.when: 当用户输入 `/exporta-cards-enriquecidos-para-epub` 命令，或通过命令行参数/环境变量指定书名时触发。

say.text: 把卡片导出成 EPUB 电子书。
用“我的学习卡片”作为书名导出 EPUB。
say.note: 书名会出现在封面和元数据中。

howto.what_en: Converts all `*-enriched-card.md` files in the current directory into an EPUB e-book with cover, table of contents, and each card's question and answer, optimized for mobile reading.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs the `/exporta-cards-enriquecidos-para-epub` command, or provides a book title via command-line argument or environment variable.

say_en.text: Export the cards as an EPUB e-book.
Export EPUB with title 'My Study Cards'.
say_en.note: The title appears on the cover and in metadata.
